alt: Underwater seafloor with caustic light. In front, a pale blue coral with one trunk splitting into seven short branches; three thin orange strands bridge across between branch tips. Behind it, six dark bleached corals fade into the haze.

An underwater coral on a sandy floor with rippling light. Its older branches are grey-blue, the newest tips glow white, and thin orange strands join branch ends across the coral. Bleached grey corals stand in the haze behind.
